GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (24 Dec 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 497)
24 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of the Japanese Legation Staff and Families.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. No.799 (1.1), dated 30 November 1945, subject as above.
2. Information available in this headquarters indicates that subject persons will be repatriated through India.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
